name: Rohit Vishnu Mopuri
work_right: Applied for ILR (Indefinite Leave to Remain)
summary: Data Integration Architect with 15 years across enterprise integration, cloud data engineering, and API management. Comfortable going deep on architecture one day and hands-on in a production pipeline the next. Client-facing throughout: designing reference architectures, running technical advisory workshops, managing scope and timelines, and working through escalations. Delivered greenfield data lakehouse platforms, event-driven integration, and APIM governance for clients spanning banking, automotive, aviation, and telecoms. Worked across the full data engineering stack: Apache Iceberg, PySpark, Airflow, Kafka, MuleSoft, Apigee, and AWS.

experience.title: Data Integration Lead | Cloud Data Architect
experience.highlight: West Bromwich Building Society (WBBS) – Banking Data Platform
description: Architected and delivered a greenfield cloud-native data lakehouse as a reusable product framework, with pluggable data interfaces, config-driven pipelines, and a standardised medallion architecture built to onboard other UK building societies quickly.

Enabled real-time FPS/BACS payment processing, automated FCA regulatory reporting, and cut reconciliation effort by 80%. Reduced overnight batch windows to hourly runs and a 4-hour manual GL process to 15 minutes. The platform now runs WBBS's savings, deposits, ISA, and mortgage data flows.
Designed four-layer medallion architecture (Raw → Conformed → Derived → Provisioned) on Apache Iceberg (AWS S3 Tables) with ACID compliance, time travel, snapshot-based CDC, and SCD Type 1 MERGE.

Diagnosed and resolved 110 TB / 1.38M file metadata bloat caused by unbounded Iceberg metadata-log chain accumulation, using table optimisation techniques including snapshot management and orphan file deletion.
Designed event-driven integration using Apache Kafka + Avro + Karapace Schema Registry with exactly-once semantics and full audit trail via event sourcing.

Orchestrated 30+ Airflow DAGs on MWAA with S3KeySensor file-arrival triggers, dynamic micro-batch windowing via GlueJobOperator, Iceberg maintenance DAGs, and ExternalTaskSensor cross-pipeline coordination. Fully portable across 6 environments via config-driven Airflow Variables.
Built 50+ PySpark Glue jobs with end-to-end CI/CD across 6 environments (dev → prd); 10,000+ lines of production Python.
Implemented ISO 20022 (PAIN.001/002, SESE.111) XSD validation, PGP encryption, GuardDuty scanning, and Lake Formation RBAC for FCA regulatory compliance.
Designed custom Dynatrace observability dashboards for pipeline health, ingestion latency, and exception trend monitoring.

Bentley Motors: Built an API-led digital platform using MuleSoft microservices with Anypoint MQ for async event handling, clearing technical debt and cutting delivery time.
Bentley Motors: Provisioned AWS queue infrastructure (SQS/SNS) with dead letter queue failover for integration resiliency; implemented CI/CD via Git and AWS CodePipeline.
